resultJson.description:
Slice 1 of 4 of #8 (ADR `docs/adr/0001-adr-start-spotify-from-spotify-refresh-token-fall.md`). This slice adds the contracts the later slices build on and changes no sign-in behaviour. `SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN` becomes optional: `application.conf` sets `refresh-token = ""` and then overrides it with `${?SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN}`, and `SpotifyCredentials.refreshToken` defaults to `""`. That way a missing or empty token is no longer a config error at startup. The new pure method `SpotifyCredentials.configuredRefreshToken` returns the trimmed token, or `None` when the token is blank. Slice 3 will start sessions from it.

The typed `client.SpotifyTokenError` is added, a sealed `RuntimeException` with cases `Rejected` and `Failed` and a pure classifier `of(call, status, body)`. Only a 400 whose body has `error: invalid_grant` is `Rejected`. Every other unsuccessful answer is `Failed`: 429, `invalid_client` on 400 or 401, any 5xx, and any body that can't be parsed. No message contains the token that was sent. `SpotifyClient.renew` now goes through a private `refreshWith(call, refresh)` and raises `SpotifyTokenError` instead of a bare `RuntimeException`. Its behaviour is otherwise the same: call name "Renew", the same TLS naming, the same session update and the same INFO log. All existing renewal tests pass unchanged (AC 7).

The new `client.SignInCodes[F]` trait (`attempt`, `hand`) and `SignInCodes.once(deferred)` are added. `SpotifyClient`'s primary constructor, `callbackRoutes` and `serverResource` now take `SignInCodes[F]`. An auxiliary `Deferred` constructor stays, so every `new SpotifyClient[IO](…, deferred)` call site compiles unchanged.

There are two deviations from the ADR, both to be recorded in the PR:
- No `Deferred` overload of `callbackRoutes`. The project's Scalafix config has `SameParamOverloading` in `lint.error`, and two same-arity `callbackRoutes` methods would fail `sbt check`. Turning the rule off isn't allowed. The overload's only caller is one test line, which is changed to wrap its `Deferred` with `SignInCodes.once`.
- No `SignInCodes.make`. It is slice 2's retry behaviour. Here, `SpotifyClient.resource` builds a `Deferred` and wraps it with `SignInCodes.once`, which keeps today's single-attempt flow and avoids shipping `???` or untested code.

`signIn`, the `getOrRefresh` change and removing the sp_dc cookie are out of scope (slices 3 and 4). `initialAuth` keeps requesting `/authorize` with the cookie, and keeps its `creds.refreshToken` fallback.

tasks.title: Make SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN optional and add SpotifyCredentials.configuredRefreshToken
tasks.description:
Changes:
- `src/main/resources/application.conf`: replace `refresh-token = ${SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN}` with two lines, `refresh-token = ""` and then `refresh-token = ${?SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN}`.
- `src/main/scala/domain/spotify/SpotifyCredentials.scala`: set `refreshToken: String = ""`, then add a brace body after `derives Codec.AsObject` containing `def configuredRefreshToken: Option[String] = Some(refreshToken.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty)` with the ADR's doc comment. Keep `trim`, as the ADR says "trimmed". The circe shape stays the same.

Tests:
- `LightShowConfigSpec`: turn the test "the shipped application.conf loads, with the beat taken from audio" into a table with three rows: set (gives "r"), empty (gives "") and unset (gives "").
  - Remove `SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN` from the existing `${NAME}` replacement map. Otherwise the set row would pass on master.
  - The set and empty rows replace only the literal `${?SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN}` with `"r"` or `""`. The unset row leaves it in place.
  - Every row resolves without the process environment: `ConfigSource.fromConfig(ConfigFactory.parseString(resolved).resolve(ConfigResolveOptions.noSystem())).withFallback(reference)`. This matters because pureconfig's `ConfigSource.string` resolves against the env, and the conf also has `${?HUE_ZONE_ID}`.
  - Every row asserts `spotify.refreshToken`, and still asserts lightShow == `LightShowConfig(beatSource = BeatSource.Audio)` and pollingIntervalMs == 1000.
- New `src/test/scala/domain/spotify/SpotifyCredentialsSpec.scala` (a `ScalaCheckSuite`):
  - Property: strings built only from whitespace (`Gen.stringOf(Gen.oneOf(' ', '\t', '\n', '\r'))`, which includes the empty string) give `None`.
  - Property: a core from `Gen.identifier` (first and last characters are above `' '`, so `trim` leaves it intact), padded with generated ASCII whitespace on either side, gives `Some(core)`.
  - A test that `SpotifyCredentials("id", "secret").refreshToken == ""`.

tasks.title: Add SpotifyTokenError with the pure classifier of
tasks.description:
Create `src/main/scala/client/SpotifyTokenError.scala` exactly as in the ADR's program design, in brace syntax:
- `sealed abstract class SpotifyTokenError(message: String) extends RuntimeException(message)`
- `final case class Rejected(call: String, status: Status, body: String)` with the message `s"Spotify rejected the $call, $status: $body"`
- `final case class Failed(call: String, status: Status, body: String)` with the message `s"Spotify $call failed, $status: $body"`

Implement `def of(call: String, status: Status, body: String): SpotifyTokenError`. It returns `Rejected` when `status == Status.BadRequest` and `io.circe.parser.parse(body)` gives a top-level string field `error` equal to `"invalid_grant"`. Everything else returns `Failed`, including bodies that aren't JSON and `error` values that aren't strings. Keep it pure.

Tests: new `src/test/scala/client/SpotifyTokenErrorSpec.scala` (a `ScalaCheckSuite`). Use pattern matches rather than `isInstanceOf`, because `DisableSyntax.noIsInstanceOf` is on.
- Property: over generated unsuccessful statuses (`Status.fromInt` over 300–599, or `Status.registered` filtered by `!_.isSuccess`) crossed with generated error codes, `of` returns `Rejected` exactly when the status is 400 and the code is `invalid_grant`.
  - Codes: `invalid_grant`, `invalid_client`, `invalid_request`, `unsupported_grant_type`, plus arbitrary strings.
  - Build the JSON bodies with `Json.obj("error" -> Json.fromString(code)).noSpaces`, not string interpolation, so that quotes and backslashes stay valid JSON.
  - Also include separate non-JSON bodies, and a body whose `error` isn't a string.
- Property: the call, status and body are carried unchanged.
- Table with five rows: 429 gives Failed, 400 invalid_client gives Failed, 401 invalid_client gives Failed, 400 invalid_grant gives Rejected, 503 gives Failed.
- Property: the message contains the call and the body.

tasks.title: Route renew through refreshWith so it raises SpotifyTokenError
tasks.description:
In `src/main/scala/client/SpotifyClient.scala`, keep the colon/indent style the file uses. Add `private def refreshWith(call: String, refresh: String): F[String]`, built from the current body of `renew`:
- It POSTs to `authUri` with `UrlForm("grant_type" -> "refresh_token", "refresh_token" -> refresh)` and `Authorization(BasicCredentials(creds.clientId, creds.clientSecret))`.
- Wrap it in `naming(call)(client.expectOr[SpotifyToken](req) { errorRes => errorRes.bodyText.compile.string.flatMap(body => Async[F].raiseError(SpotifyTokenError.of(call, errorRes.status, body))) })`.
- Then `session.set(Some(SpotifySession(resp.access_token, resp.refresh_token.getOrElse(refresh))))`, then return the access token.

`renew` becomes: read `refresh` from `session.get.map(_.fold(creds.refreshToken)(_.refreshToken))`, then `refreshWith("Renew", refresh)`, then log the existing INFO line `Renewed the Spotify access token`. Keep the log in `renew`, not in `refreshWith`: slice 3's swap reuses `refreshWith` and logs its own line. Keep the ADR's doc comments. The call name must stay "Renew", which `SpotifyTlsSpec` asserts through `SpotifyTlsFailure("Renew", _)`.

Tests:
- Leave the existing `SpotifyClientSpec` renewal tests untouched. They must still pass: the failing-renew test intercepts `RuntimeException`, which `SpotifyTokenError` extends.
- Add one property in a new `src/test/scala/client/SpotifyRenewSpec.scala` (a `ScalaCheckSuite`):
  - Generate a distinctive refresh token: `Gen.identifier` with a fixed prefix such as `rt-`, at least 16 characters long.
  - Generate an unsuccessful status and an error body that doesn't contain the token, such as `{"error":"invalid_grant"}` or `{"error":"invalid_client"}`.
  - Build a `SpotifyClient` with session `Some(SpotifySession("expired", token))` and a `Client.fromHttpApp` fake whose `POST /api/token` answers with that status and body.
  - Run `renew.attempt.unsafeRunSync()` (with `cats.effect.unsafe.implicits.global`) and pattern match: `case Left(e: SpotifyTokenError) =>` the call is "Renew" (match `Rejected(call, _, _) | Failed(call, _, _)`) and `!e.getMessage.contains(token)`. Any other case is false. Don't use `isInstanceOf`, which the lint disallows.

tasks.title: Add SignInCodes with once, and switch SpotifyClient to it
tasks.description:
Create `src/main/scala/client/SignInCodes.scala` in brace syntax, with the ADR's trait and doc comments:
- `trait SignInCodes[F[_]] { def attempt: F[F[String]]; def hand(code: String): F[Boolean] }`
- `object SignInCodes { def once[F[_]: Applicative](deferred: Deferred[F, String]): SignInCodes[F] }`, where `attempt = deferred.get.pure[F]` and `hand(code) = deferred.complete(code)`.
- Don't add `make` (slice 2).

In `SpotifyClient.scala`:
- The primary constructor's 4th parameter becomes `codes: SignInCodes[F]`.
- Add the auxiliary constructor `def this(client: Client[F], creds: SpotifyCredentials, session: Ref[F, Option[SpotifySession]], authCode: Deferred[F, String]) = this(client, creds, session, SignInCodes.once[F](authCode))`, with the ADR's doc comment.
- In `initialAuth`, replace `authCodeDeferred.get` with `codes.attempt.flatten`. Leave everything else: `/authorize` with the cookie, "Code Exchange", and the `getOrElse(creds.refreshToken)` fallback.
- Companion object:
  - `callbackRoutes[F[_]: Async](codes: SignInCodes[F])` hands the code with `codes.hand(code) *> Ok("Success! Return to your terminal.")`, keeping the same route and response.
  - Do not add a `Deferred` overload of `callbackRoutes`. Scalafix's `SameParamOverloading` is in `lint.error` and would fail `sbt check` (deviation from the ADR, recorded in the PR).
  - `serverResource[F[_]: Async: Network](codes: SignInCodes[F])`.
  - `resource` builds `Deferred[F, String]`, wraps it in `SignInCodes.once`, and passes that to `serverResource` and the constructor.
- Run `sbt lint` straight after the signature changes. The secondary constructor shouldn't be flagged, since it isn't a `def`. If it is flagged, replace the auxiliary constructor with a non-overloaded companion factory and update the constructor call sites. Never disable the rule.

Tests:
- Change only `SpotifyClientSpec.scala:140` to `SpotifyClient.callbackRoutes[IO](SignInCodes.once(code))`. That existing callback test then covers the new route; add no other callback test.
- All other suites (SpotifyClientSpec, SpotifyTlsSpec, SpotifyTlsEngineSpec, SyncEngineRunSpec) must compile and pass unchanged through the auxiliary constructor.
- Add `src/test/scala/client/SignInCodesSpec.scala` (a CatsEffectSuite) for `once`:
  - The first `hand` returns true and a second returns false.
  - `attempt.flatten` yields the handed code.
  - `attempt` waits until a code is handed. Test this under `TestControl.executeEmbed`: `codes.attempt.flatMap(_.timeout(1.second).attempt)` gives `Left(_: TimeoutException)` before any `hand`. Then, after `hand("c")`, `codes.attempt.flatten` yields "c". No sleeps, no polling a fiber.

resultJson.brief:
Project: a Scala 3 app (sbt 3.9.0, Typelevel stack) that drives Hue lights from Spotify playback. Read CLAUDE.md first. Rules:
- New code uses brace syntax and `given`/`using`. Existing `SpotifyClient.scala` uses colon/indent syntax (`-indent` is in scalacOptions); match the style of the file you edit.
- Use `F[_]: Async`, `Ref`, `Deferred` and `Resource`. No `Future`, no `unsafeRun*` in main code (tests already use `unsafeRunSync` with `cats.effect.unsafe.implicits.global`).
- Errors are typed. Comment only what the code can't say. Test names say what they check, with no comments in tests.
- Finish with `sbt fix`, then `sbt check`. Coverage gates are 90% statements and 85% branches overall, and 70% statements per file. Don't lower them, add exclusions, or turn off Scalafix rules.
- Never print or log `.env`, credentials, `SpotifyCredentials` or `AppConfig`.

Lint traps. `.scalafix.conf` (main) and `.scalafix.test.conf` (tests) both have these in `lint.error`:
- `SameParamOverloading` (xuwei-k): same-named methods with the same number of parameters fail the lint. So there's no `Deferred` overload of `callbackRoutes`.
- `DisableSyntax.noIsInstanceOf = true`: use pattern matches in tests.
- Also `OptionContains`, `IsEmptyNonEmpty`, `StringFormatToInterpolation`, `DubiousLiteral` and others. Run `sbt lint` early.

Design source: `docs/adr/0001-adr-start-spotify-from-spotify-refresh-token-fall.md`. Its "Program design" section has the exact signatures and doc comments for `SpotifyTokenError`, `SignInCodes`, the `SpotifyClient` diff and `SpotifyCredentials`. This issue is slice 1 only. Do not implement `signIn`, change `getOrRefresh`, remove the sp_dc cookie or `/authorize` GET, add `SignInCodes.make`, or touch docs/README/build.sbt. Recorded deviations: no `Deferred` overload of `callbackRoutes` (lint), and no `make` (slice 2).

Key files:
- `src/main/resources/application.conf`: the `spotify { client-id = ${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID}; client-secret = ${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET}; refresh-token = ${SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN} }` block. It also has `hue.zone-id = ${?HUE_ZONE_ID}` and `hue.creds` (`HUE_BRIDGE_ADDRESS`, `HUE_USERNAME`, `HUE_PSK`), plus `polling-interval-ms = 1000` and `light-show.beat-source = "audio"`. `reference.conf` holds the defaults. Ignore `target/` copies.
- `src/main/scala/domain/spotify/SpotifyCredentials.scala`: `case class SpotifyCredentials(clientId: String, clientSecret: String, refreshToken: String) derives Codec.AsObject`.
- `src/main/scala/domain/config/AppConfig.scala`: `case class AppConfig(spotify: SpotifyCredentials, hue: HueConfig, pollingIntervalMs: Int = 2000, lightShow: LightShowConfig = LightShowConfig(), ui: UiConfig = UiConfig()) derives ConfigReader`. pureconfig uses case-class default args and kebab-case keys.
- `src/main/scala/domain/spotify/SpotifySession.scala`: `case class SpotifySession(accessToken: String, refreshToken: String)`. `SpotifyToken` has fields `access_token` and `refresh_token: Option[String]`.
- `src/main/scala/client/SpotifyClient.scala`:
  - Class: `class SpotifyClient[F[_]: Async: Network](client: Client[F], creds: SpotifyCredentials, session: Ref[F, Option[SpotifySession]], authCodeDeferred: Deferred[F, String]) extends Http4sClientDsl[F]`.
  - Private members: `authUri = uri"https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token"`, `logger = Slf4jLogger.getLogger[F]`, and `naming[A](call: String)(fa: F[A]): F[A]`, which wraps any TLS-caused error as `SpotifyTlsFailure(call, err)`.
  - `initialAuth`: logs "Please visit", GETs /authorize with the sp_dc cookie, waits on `authCodeDeferred.get`, then the "Code Exchange" POST.
  - `getOrRefresh`; `renew` (currently raises `RuntimeException("Couldn't renew the Spotify access token, $status: $body")` under `naming("Renew")`, and logs INFO "Renewed the Spotify access token"); `authorised` renews once on a 401.
  - Companion: `callbackRoutes(deferred)` (GET /callback?code= returns Ok("Success! Return to your terminal."), using `CodeMatcher`), `serverResource(deferred)` (Ember on 127.0.0.1:7070) and `resource(client, creds)`.
  - Only `Main.scala:31` calls it, through `SpotifyClient.resource`.
- Tests that construct `new SpotifyClient[IO](client, SpotifyCredentials("id","secret","refresh…"), sessionRef, deferred)`: `src/test/scala/client/SpotifyClientSpec.scala`, `client/SpotifyTlsSpec.scala`, `SpotifyTlsEngineSpec.scala` and `SyncEngineRunSpec.scala`. Only `SpotifyClientSpec.scala:140` calls `SpotifyClient.callbackRoutes[IO](code)`.
- `SpotifyTlsSpec` asserts call names through `SpotifyTlsFailure(call, _)`: "Renew", "Authorize", "Code Exchange", "Playback Poll", "Tempo Lookup".
- `SpotifyClientSpec`'s `expiring(renewal)` fake records the `refresh_token` form field and is a template for fakes: `HttpRoutes.of[IO]{ case req @ POST -> Root / "api" / "token" => ... }.orNotFound` passed to `Client.fromHttpApp`. Its failing-renew test intercepts `RuntimeException`.
- `src/test/scala/domain/config/LightShowConfigSpec.scala`: a munit `FunSuite`.
  - It has `reference = ConfigSource.resources("reference.conf")`.
  - The shipped-conf test (lines 77–87) reads `scala.io.Source.fromResource("application.conf")` and string-replaces `${NAME}` keys from a map; `SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN` is in it at line 80.
  - Pitfall: `ConfigSource.string(...)` resolves substitutions against the system environment. Use `ConfigSource.fromConfig(ConfigFactory.parseString(s).resolve(ConfigResolveOptions.noSystem()))`; the classes come from `com.typesafe.config`.

Test conventions:
- ScalaCheck suites extend `munit.ScalaCheckSuite`, use `property("…") { forAll(gen) { … } }`, and import `org.scalacheck.{Gen, Prop}` and `Prop.forAll`. See `src/test/scala/domain/hue/PskSpec.scala`, which has a "never echoes the input" property.
- Effectful suites extend `munit.CatsEffectSuite` and use `.assertEquals` / `.intercept`.
- Use `cats.effect.testkit.TestControl` for anything timed or waiting; no sleeps.
- munit-scalacheck-effect is not a dependency, so effectful properties call `unsafeRunSync()` inside `forAll`.
- Build JSON in generators with circe (`Json.obj(...).noSpaces`), not interpolation.

Libraries available in root: circe-core/generic/parser (`io.circe.parser.parse`, `io.circe.Json`), http4s 0.23 (`org.http4s.Status`, `Status.BadRequest`, `Status.fromInt`, `Status.registered`, `status.isSuccess`), pureconfig 0.17, cats-effect 3.6 and testkit, munit 1.0, munit-scalacheck 1.0, munit-cats-effect 2.0.

Non-obvious points:
- Spotify's token error body looks like `{"error":"invalid_grant","error_description":"…"}`. Classify on the top-level `error` string only.
- Keep `renew`'s fallback to `creds.refreshToken` when there's no session.
- Keep the INFO renew log in `renew`, not in `refreshWith`.
- `Deferred.complete` returns `F[Boolean]` (false if already completed), which fits `hand`.
- `String.trim` strips only characters ≤ ' ', so generate non-blank cores with `Gen.identifier`.
